evidence.name: Screen field: Space around the image
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Space around the image" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Space around the image
sections.description: Sets the empty space, in pixels, on each side of the step image: top, right, bottom, left. The default is usually 0; add padding so the image does not touch the title or screen edges and sits balanced in its container. A well-framed visual carries the emotional pull on an ad landing page, so adjust this when the image looks cramped or off-center. This control appears only for the Image First or Chart First layouts.
